notes.note: Reviewed only the new concrete-interface control topology: the public bind remains exact, an IPv4 loopback API socket serves the same middleware, local readiness/UI proxy use it, supervisor handoff retains it, and failed control binds roll back. Owners are stationHonoServer, SupervisorLink, TerminalGateway and lifecycle start. Linux integrated real CLI lifecycle passed 8 tests at 18bea957d, including LAN local-grant refusal and listening consent. Windows listener and admission tests passed, but Windows restart load and PTY cleanup have separate red evidence; this is not all-platform or packaged qualification. No new network trust or preview capability is granted.

Checked --host/start and supervisor listener descriptions against lifecycle start, the concrete-interface plus loopback Hono binds, actual-bound-address selection, rollback and Linux real CLI lifecycle. Corrected the former claim that terminal was a separate listener; confirmed consent follows the runtime's configured host. Consent state now probes authenticated loopback while its banner retains the configured consent address. Ordinary wildcard/default and managed-policy admission remain unchanged. Windows bind/admission evidence does not establish zero-reset handoff or packaged release usability.

Reviewed the implemented listener paragraph, not a redesign of this historical/proposal document: api-local is a named retained socket only when the actual public socket does not cover IPv4 loopback; API/voice/consent retain existing ownership. Linux integrated start/restart/rebake/stop passed; terminal shared-capacity, both-listener teardown, remount and heartbeat catch/restoration passed. Earlier dated adoption evidence remains historical and does not become a Windows zero-reset claim; a Windows load reset is under separate investigation. No protocol authority, readiness budget or remote credential admission was widened.
